name: Liquid Global
rootCause: Liquid, a Japanese-based cryptocurrency exchange, said its hot wallet was attacked and it was transferring assets to cold wallets. It is currently investigating and has suspended its deposit and withdrawal services.

descriptions.text: Liquid, a Japanese-based cryptocurrency exchange, said its hot wallet was attacked and it was transferring assets to cold wallets. It is currently investigating and has suspended its deposit and withdrawal services.

Liquid Global's warm wallets were compromised on August 19, 2021, resulting in the theft of approximately $91.35 million in crypto assets across several chains. The attacker gained control of wallet keys, leading to coordinated withdrawals and conversion efforts before some assets could be frozen or traced. The attacker gained unauthorized access to the private keys (or equivalent approval factors) controlling Liquid Global's warm wallets, enabling immediate multi-chain asset withdrawals. The precise technical attack vector was not publicly disclosed.
